description:
YITAMOTOR provides you with the best innovative, quality products & professional services at competitive prices. We are confident that our products will surpass your expectations and make you a happy customer!
Fitment
2015 Jeep Cherokee ( Not for Raised Floor in Front of Your Dead Pedal)
2016 - 2023 Jeep Cherokee
Not for Grand Cherokee
Does Not for Vinyl Flooring,only for carpet flooring.
For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
Features
Custom Fit: These floor mats are fit for 2016-2023 Jeep Cherokee (Not fit for Grand Cherokee) and fit for 2015 Jeep Cherokee (Excludes Cherokee raised floor), not for vehicles with vinyl floors. 3D laser scanning technology gives full protection to both the front and back. Please remove old floor mats before installing new ones.
Safe & Durable: YITAMOTOR floor liners are made with odorless TPE material, ensuring safety even in extreme hot weather. The product contains no latex, cadmium, lead, or any harmful PVC’s. High tensity TPE material not only provides a superb feel and extreme wear-resistance, but also remains flexible in even the harshest of cold weather.
All Season Protection & Non-Slip: The unique designed channels and raised edge can effectively trap liquids, snow, and sand to keep your car and shoes clean. Even in wet conditions, the hooks can effectively prevent the mats from slipping. The mats are available for you.
Easy To Clean: The textured skid-resistant surface is easily cleaned. Neither cumbersome vacuum cleaners nor harsh chemicals are needed; simply shake them out or spray them down with a hose.
Why Choose Yitamotor: Our floor mats are processed with advanced technology, rendering tailored protection and all-weather guard to your vehicle.
